name: Dundo

queries.query: Dundo Angola official cadastral parcel map GIS cadastro Dundo Lunda Norte
queries.result: Official Lunda-Norte material identifies a Provincial IGCA (Instituto Geográfico e Cadastral de Angola) service located in Dundo. No public anonymous parcel viewer, downloadable parcel layer, or parcel ID+geometry API was found in the search results.

queries.query: Dundo Angola cadastro predial mapa parcelas serviço oficial
queries.result: Os resultados oficiais confirmam o serviço provincial do IGCA localizado no Dundo e os portais nacionais de cadastro/registo predial. Não foi encontrado um visualizador público anónimo nem uma resposta de parcelas com identificador nativo e geometria.

researchNote: A local cadastral custodian is evidenced by the official Lunda-Norte portal, which states that the Provincial IGCA service is located in Dundo. The public sources expose procedures and national agency information, not an anonymous parcel data service. No sample GeoJSON is retained because no safe native parcel identity and unchanged full polygon were returned. Runtime readiness remains held pending independent serial-adapter qualification.
